# Waterloo Heating & Cooling

> Licensed, insured HVAC company in Waterloo, Ontario. A full-service heating and cooling team handling furnace and AC repair, heat pumps, ductless systems, thermostats, and duct cleaning, plus seasonal maintenance, for homeowners across Waterloo and Waterloo Region. Call (519) 888-7222.
